title: Big Picture diagram still lists Extensions client panel
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely — all extension CSS/browser/server payload execution is gone, Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes deleted; startup permanently erases retained server records and extension-storage:* settings, and UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records.
fix: Remove '- Extensions' from the client box in the diagram (keep Chat UI, Agents panel, Lorebook editor).

title: Extension core-object section describes a removed feature
reality: The Extension feature (client-side CSS+JS with a scoped marinara API) was completely removed in v2.3.4, including authoring guides, examples, and Professor Mari instructions; API routes and client hooks are deleted and startup erases retained extension records.
fix: Delete the '### Extension' core-object section including the references/extensions.md pointer; add a one-line historical note that extensions were removed in v2.3.4 with startup cleanup.

title: Data Storage list still includes extensions
reality: v2.3.4 deleted extension storage; startup permanently erases every retained server extension record and extension-storage:* setting. Themes still exist (Settings > Addons).
fix: Change 'themes, extensions' to 'themes'; note the v2.3.4 startup purge of legacy extension records.

title: 'What's NOT Built-In' claims CSS/JS extensions remain manual installs
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension mechanism entirely — there is no client extension system at all anymore; only themes remain as an addon surface.
fix: Rewrite the bullet: drop 'CSS/JS extensions remain manual installs'; add that as of v2.3.4 there is NO client extension/plugin mechanism (feature removed; customization = themes, custom tools, agents, or forking).

title: Conversation group turns described as single merged generation only
reality: v2.3.4 (#3887) added Grouped AND Individual response modes with sequential, smart, manual, mention-directed, and autonomous character selection, a shared daily check-in budget, and a token-use warning. Supersedes the v2.3.1 model (#3609).
fix: Replace the Group DMs paragraph: two response modes (Grouped merged generation vs Individual per-character replies), five selection strategies, shared daily check-in budget, token-use warning; keep #3609 only as Grouped display behavior.

title: Missing mention-directed responder behavior / Reply When Mentioned removal
reality: v2.3.4 (#3891) made Conversation character mentions always select the mentioned responder(s), including legacy manual-response chats, and removed the redundant Reply When Mentioned toggle.
fix: Add to the Conversation group section (#3891).

title: Missing check-in ceiling overrides and 50-message summary-tail ceiling removal
reality: v2.3.4 (#3864) added explicit numeric overrides for Conversation chat check-in ceilings and removed the 50-message ceiling from Conversation and Roleplay recent-summary tails.
fix: Add to the Chat Summary paragraph and/or Conversation section (#3864).

title: Noodle refresh missing local time and schedule attachment
reality: v2.3.4 (#3886) added the user's current local time to every Noodle timeline refresh and an optional setting for attaching participating characters' existing generated schedules for the current day.
fix: Add to the Noodle Refresh paragraph (#3886).

title: Noodle JSON robustness fixes absent
reality: v2.3.4 recovers every Noodle timeline collection when local models return adjacent JSON objects (#3881) and accepts single-object array wrappers for generated profiles, preventing HTTP 500 on first-time bio generation (#3871).
fix: One sentence in the Noodle Refresh paragraph (#3881, #3871).

title: ComfyUI listed as image-only; local ComfyUI video generation missing
reality: v2.3.4 (#3804) added local ComfyUI VIDEO generation for API-format WAN and other workflows with prompt/size/seed/frame-count/first-frame placeholders; the five-cloud-profile Video Generation list is no longer exhaustive. #3749 shipped an in-app + GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide.
fix: Add local ComfyUI video to the Video Generation bullet (#3804); mention the workflow guide (#3749).

title: Launcher update-check behavior when auto-update disabled
reality: v2.3.4: with AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false, launchers perform a read-only latest-release check and print a console reminder; --skip-update suppresses checks for one launch.
fix: Extend the env-vars bullet.

title: SSE streaming after tab-visibility changes
reality: v2.3.4 keeps healthy SSE replies streaming after a backgrounded tab becomes visible again, with a grace period before falling back to the persisted full response.
fix: Add near the /api/generate SSE endpoint.

title: Prompt leaf content is now verbatim (no HTML-escaping)
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content (card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, scene text reach the model verbatim). Supersedes #3108 and the untrusted-card-text escaping; structural wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers unchanged.
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note in Prompt Assembly.

title: Cross-chat awareness described as hardcoded <awareness> XML

fix: Update the Cross-chat awareness bullet and the Connected chats <influence>/<ooc> bullet (#3753).

title: Cross-Chat Awareness UI consolidated under Connected Chats
reality: v2.3.4 (#3889) consolidated Cross-Chat Awareness under Connected Chats.
fix: Note in the Special Features bullets (#3889).

title: Character/Persona prompt section order not documented

title: Scene-video streaming now byte-range instead of full buffering

title: TTS dialogue pause control changed to whole seconds 1-60
reality: v2.3.4 changed the TTS dialogue pause control to whole seconds 1-60, migrating legacy sub-second and no-pause values to the 1-second minimum.
fix: Update the TTS/voice bullet.

title: Roleplay Stop now cancels server-side immediately
reality: v2.3.4 sends the explicit server cancellation through the authenticated API client when Stop is pressed.
fix: Add a sentence in Roleplay Mode / generation pipeline.

title: Macros bullet missing {{group}} and conditional operators
reality: v2.3.4 added {{group}} and conditional-macro operators (||, &&, parentheses, equality-list shorthand).

reality: v2.3.4 (#3861) added disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories with manual preview/apply, trust confirmation, stable sync identity, SSRF-safe validation; #3953 hardened imports (fresh custom identity, no bundled functions/tools).
